Deployment Strategist — Halden Systems
New York, NY (Hybrid, 3 days/week in our Flatiron office)

About Halden
Halden Systems builds AI software that helps the U.S. defense industrial base plan production and
manage supplier risk. Our platform uses machine learning models to forecast part shortages and
recommend mitigation across thousands of suppliers. We're a Series C company backed by leading
defense and enterprise investors, working with the Army, Navy and prime contractors.

The role
Deployment Strategists are the bridge between our customers' hardest operational problems and our
product. You'll embed with program offices and manufacturing customers, scope their problems, design
the deployment, and drive adoption with senior stakeholders. You will not write code — you'll work
alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers, who own the technical integration.

What you'll do
- Own the end-to-end deployment of Halden at 3–5 customer accounts
- Run discovery with program managers, supply-chain leads and executives; translate needs into
  deployment plans and success metrics
- Lead change management and executive business reviews
- Feed customer insight to product and help shape the roadmap
- Support proposal and contracting work for new government programs

What we're looking for
- 5+ years in management consulting, strategy & operations, or customer deployment roles
- Experience working with government, defense or industrial customers
- Excellent written and executive communication
- Comfort with data: SQL or spreadsheet analysis is a plus
- Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance

Compensation
The base salary range for this role in New York is $170,000–$210,000, plus equity and benefits.
Travel to customer sites up to 25%.

Strategy & Operations Lead — Ledgerline (NYSE: LDGR)
New York, NY · Hybrid

Ledgerline builds AI agents that automate regulatory compliance for banks and insurers — from
monitoring rule changes to drafting regulatory filings. Our models are deployed at more than 200
financial institutions. Ledgerline is a publicly traded company headquartered in New York.

About the role
Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you'll join a small Strategy & Operations team that runs
the company's planning process and leads cross-functional strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities
- Run the annual and quarterly planning process and the executive operating cadence
- Lead 2–3 strategic initiatives at a time (e.g. entering a new regulatory vertical, go-to-market
  expansion, operating model changes)
- Build business cases and financial models to support executive decisions
- Partner with Finance, Product, and Sales leadership to track company goals and KPIs
- Prepare board and executive materials

Qualifications
- 6+ years of experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or BizOps
- Strong financial modeling and analytical skills (Excel/Sheets; SQL a plus)
- Track record leading cross-functional programs to completion
- Experience in financial services, compliance, or regulated industries preferred
- Bachelor's degree required; MBA or MPP a plus

Pay
Base salary range: $165,000 – $195,000. Eligible for annual bonus and RSUs.

Business Operations Manager — Corvid Freight
New York, NY (in office, Monday–Thursday)

Corvid Freight is a digital freight brokerage connecting shippers with carriers across North America.
We use technology and machine learning to price loads and match trucks, and our marketplace moves
thousands of shipments every week.

We're looking for a Business Operations Manager to help our brokerage team scale. You'll sit in the
operations org and work with carrier sales, pricing and customer success.

What you'll do
- Own weekly operating metrics for the brokerage floor (margin per load, tender acceptance, on-time %)
- Identify process bottlenecks and run improvement projects
- Build dashboards and ad-hoc analyses in SQL and Excel
- Support carrier sales leadership with territory planning and headcount models
- Manage special projects for the VP of Operations

What you bring
- 3–5 years in operations, BizOps, or consulting, ideally in logistics or a marketplace business
- Strong SQL and Excel skills
- Comfort in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
- Freight brokerage experience strongly preferred

Competitive salary and benefits. Some evening coverage during peak season.

Strategic Initiatives Manager — Arbiter AI
Remote (United States)

Arbiter AI builds large-language-model software that helps state and local governments process
permits and benefits applications faster. We're a Series B company serving 40+ public agencies.

We are a fully remote company with no offices; the team gathers in person twice a year.

About the role
Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you'll lead high-priority strategic initiatives across the business:
public-sector go-to-market planning, partnership strategy with systems integrators, and internal
operating improvements.

You will
- Scope and lead cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through execution
- Build business cases, market sizing and financial models
- Drive the quarterly OKR process and exec reporting
- Coordinate with state and local government partners on pilot programs

You have
- 5+ years in strategy consulting, strategy & operations, or government
- Experience selling to or working in the public sector
- Excellent writing and executive presence

Compensation: $160,000 – $190,000 base (U.S. national range) plus equity.

Forward Deployed Engineer — Vantor
New York, NY — Hybrid (3 days in office)

Vantor builds an AI platform that helps energy utilities predict equipment failures and optimize
grid maintenance. We raised a $90M Series C last year and serve 30 utilities across the U.S.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer you'll work on-site with utility customers to integrate Vantor with
their data systems and build custom workflows on top of our platform.

Responsibilities
- Write production-quality Python and TypeScript to build customer-specific data pipelines and
  applications
- Integrate with customer SCADA, asset-management and GIS systems via APIs
- Debug and deploy models in customer cloud environments (AWS, Azure)
- Partner with customers' operations teams to scope and prioritize use cases

Requirements
- BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (required)
- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with TypeScript/React a plus
- Experience with cloud infrastructure and data engineering tools (Spark, Airflow)
- Willingness to travel to customer sites 30%

Base salary range (New York): $175,000 – $220,000 plus equity.

Founding BizOps Lead — Quillo
New York, NY (in-person, SoHo)

Quillo is building AI copilots for procurement teams at mid-sized manufacturers. We're a 6-person
team that just closed a $3M seed round led by top-tier investors, and we're hiring our first
business hire.

You'll work directly with our two co-founders on everything that isn't engineering: customer
onboarding, pricing, finance, hiring, and investor updates. This is a true generalist role — expect
to wear many hats.

What you'll do
- Own customer onboarding for our first 10 design partners
- Set up our finance, legal and HR operations
- Build our pricing model and sales pipeline tracking
- Help prepare for our Series A raise

You might be a fit if
- You have 3+ years in consulting, BizOps or operations at a startup
- You're comfortable with ambiguity and scrappy execution
- You're excited about manufacturing and supply chain

Base salary: $120,000 – $135,000 + meaningful equity (0.5–1.0%).
